name: When should I consider a room addition versus moving to a new house?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider a room addition versus moving to a new house?

acceptedAnswer.text: Consider a room addition when you love your current neighborhood, your property has sufficient space, and the cost of adding on is less than the transaction costs and price difference of a new home. Additions can also allow you to customize your living space precisely to your needs without the disruption of a full move. If your current home's layout is fundamentally unsuitable, or if local zoning prevents necessary expansion, moving might be a more practical solution. Evaluate your long-term needs and finances carefully.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider a room addition when you like your location, have sufficient property space, and adding on is more cost-effective than moving to a new home.
